        "The complete six-path patch changes AllocateImapUidString, ParseUidString and AppendUid signatures and locals from uint32_t/nsMsgKey spellings to ImapUid, and renames curKey/nextKey to curUid/nextUid.         "AllocateImapUidString still takes msgCount by reference. With a complete flag state it may bridge gaps and clip a long set; a partial UID fetch discards the flag state. The accepted FolderMsgDumpLoop and Store callers advance by the returned count. The new tests always pass nullptr and therefore do not exercise flag-state gap bridging or clipping.",
        "The new TestImapUtils.ImapUidSets table checks a singleton, consecutive range, separated UIDs, two ranges and descending input. Its formatter assertions compare text and unchanged count; the parser assertion compares expanded UID arrays. Descending order is preserved by this helper in the table. The original separate AllocateUidStringFromKeys test has four ascending cases and leaves descending input commented out under Bug 2031555.",
        "All four added ASSERT_EQ call sites omit an assertion message. The count assertion's nearby comment is not a message. These calls need non-empty expected-behavior diagnostics, such as a statement that the UID set should match the expected value; no test code was changed. The first three sites remain without diagnostics in the accepted test.",
        "The historical AllocateUidStringFromKeys clones and sorts input but seeds startSequence from the original first key; its reverse-order case is explicitly disabled. This patch only adds an overlap/TODO comment to that helper, not a repair.
